ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 31593, April 6, 2021>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date three months after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Applicability)
This Decree shall apply to contracts concluded or renewed after this Decree enters into force.
